proposal.root_cause: Model fails to deduplicate join-induced rows (missing DISTINCT) and misinterprets 'which entities' questions as selecting only names/IDs instead of full row details.
proposal.what: Update system_prompt.md to explicitly instruct the model to use SELECT DISTINCT when joining one-to-many tables or selecting single attributes to avoid duplicate rows, and to use SELECT * (or all relevant columns) when the question asks for 'details', 'information', or 'which [Entity]' without specifying a particular attribute. This addresses sp0536 (duplicates), sp0600 (duplicates), and sp0755 (wrong projection).
